hints.title: Target Mean Calculation
hints.text: Every element must end up equal to target = sum(nums) // n.

hints.title: Prefix Flow Differences
hints.text: Calculate the net flow diff[i] = nums[i] - target. Prefix sums of diff indicate cumulative transfers needed across boundaries.

hints.title: Circular Array Cut Optimization
hints.text: Subtract the median of the prefix differences to find the optimal circular cut that minimizes total moves.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minMovesToBalance(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        target = sum(nums) // n
        diff = [x - target for x in nums]
        
        pref = [0] * n
        cur = 0
        for i in range(n):
            cur += diff[i]
            pref[i] = cur
        
        pref.sort()
        med = pref[n // 2]
        return sum(abs(p - med) for p in pref)
```

complexity.notes: Sorting prefix differences takes O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all n possible cut points without median logic takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix differences array uses O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects transforming circular balancing into median L1 minimization.
